GAME_MANAGER.NON_ADMIN_BOT_WARNING_DESCRIPTION:
Scryarc is operating without the 'Administrator' permission. This is generally fine, but some advanced permission configurations might require manual adjustment or could be less reliable. Specifically:

• **Bot's Own Permissions:** Scryarc will rely on its globally assigned permissions for self-management within new categories/channels. Explicit overwrites for the bot might not be applied dynamically.
• **Private Game Access:** If issues arise with private game channels not being hidden from @everyone, manual intervention may be needed.

For the most seamless experience, consider granting the 'Administrator' permission to Scryarc's highest role. If you wish to maintain granular permissions, please ensure the bot has at least 'Manage Channels' and 'Manage Roles' and is at the top of the role hierarchy.
GAME_MANAGER.NON_ADMIN_BOT_WARNING_MOD_CHANNEL: Scryarc is running without 'Administrator' permissions in this guild. Some permission configurations may behave unexpectedly. Please review the bot's permissions and role hierarchy.
GAME_MANAGER.BOT_SELF_PERM_FAILED: Critical error: Failed to apply bot's own self-management permissions to the new category. Ensure the bot has 'Manage Channels' and 'Manage Roles' and its role is positioned high in the server hierarchy.
GAME_MANAGER.BOT_TEMP_EVERYONE_PERMS_FAILED: Critical error: Failed to apply temporary '@everyone' permissions to the new category. This might indicate a severe permission issue. Ensure the bot has 'Manage Channels' and 'Manage Roles' and its role is positioned high in the server hierarchy.
GAME_MANAGER.FINAL_EVERYONE_PERMS_FAILED: Warning: Failed to apply final '@everyone' permissions for category privacy. Manual adjustment may be required. Ensure the bot has 'Manage Channels' and 'Manage Roles' and its role is positioned high in the server hierarchy.
GAME_MANAGER.ADMIN_PERM_MISSING_CATEGORY_WARN: Warning: The bot lacks 'Administrator' permission. Game category created, but initial permission setup might be incomplete. Please manually adjust permissions for roles and privacy if needed.
GAME_MANAGER.ADMIN_PERM_MISSING_CHANNEL_WARN: Warning: The bot lacks 'Administrator' permission. Channel '{channelName}' created, but initial permission setup might be incomplete. Please manually adjust permissions if needed.
GAME_MANAGER.WARNING_BOT_PERMS_SKIPPED: Warning: Bot lacks 'Administrator' permission. Some bot-specific category permissions could not be applied.
GAME_MANAGER.WARNING_TEMPLATE_PERM_FAILED: Warning: Failed to apply a specific category permission for target '{targetId}'. Manual adjustment may be required.
GAME_MANAGER.WARNING_PRIVACY_PERM_FAILED: Warning: Failed to apply final '@everyone' permissions for category privacy. Manual adjustment may be required.
GAME_MANAGER.WARNING_CONFIGURED_CATEGORY_INVALID: Warning: The configured category is invalid or inaccessible. Attempting to create a default fallback category.

HELP_COMMAND.TITLE: Scryarc Bot Help

HELP_COMMAND.CMD_ARCHIVE_GAME: Archive an existing game, making its channels read-only.
